items.title: Pay glass repair invoice
items.quote: Der Betrag ist innerhalb von 14 Tagen ab Rechnungsdatum ohne Abzug fällig.
items.computation: Private-law payment deadline, counted per §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 1 BGB from the invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) 20.11.2026, which is the triggering event and is not itself counted. The 14-day period therefore starts 21.11.2026 (day 1) and runs: Nov 21-30 = 10 days, Dec 1-4 = 4 days, totaling 14 days, so day 14 falls on 04.12.2026 (Friday). As the payer resides in NW, NW public holidays apply to a possible end-of-period shift (§ 193 BGB), but 04.12.2026 is an ordinary Friday, so no shift is needed.
